_doc: Settings for scripts/record-demo.mjs and scripts/video (see scripts/video/README.md). Keys starting with _ are notes.
_safe: CSS px the callouts (top) and subtitles (bottom) cover; clicks and highlights are scrolled out of them.
_wipes: Page-wipe label by URL regex, first match wins.
_beats: One line per beat; a beat lasts its line plus edit.voPad. Per-take numbers go in callouts, not lines (they would miss the TTS cache).

beats.line: AppShelf sells hosted WordPress sites, billed with Stripe.
Pick one of three starter templates.
Sign up in seconds. There's no email check in this demo.
Choose a template, name the site, and check that its web address is still free.
Stripe Checkout opens in test mode. Pay with Stripe's own test card number, and the payment goes through.
A Stripe webhook starts a worker that builds the site.
Here's the new site, ready to edit.
Now cancel the plan on the dashboard, and the site's licence turns inactive right away.
Visitors now see a notice that the site is archived.
Renew it from the dashboard, and pay once more with the same Stripe test card.
A few seconds later, it's back online.

endLine: Built with Next.js, Postgres, Stripe and WordPress.
